content: छाया [छो-ण <ls>Uṇ. 4. 109</ls>] .²1 Shade, shadow (changed at the end of <ab>Tat. comp.</ab> into छायम् when बाहुल्य or thickness of shade is meant; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} इक्षुच्छायनिषादिन्यः <ls>R. 4. 20</ls>; so <ls n="R.">7. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 50</ls>; <ls>Mu. 4. 21</ls>); छायामधः सानुगतां निषेव्य <ls>Ku. 1. 5</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">6. 46</ls>; अनुभवति हि मूर्ध्ना पादपस्तीव्रमुष्णं शमयति परितापं छायया संश्रितानाम् <ls>Ś. 5. 7</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 75</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 6</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 70</ls>; <ls>Me. 67</ls>. .²2 A reflected image, a reflection; छाया न मूर्छति मलोपहतप्रसादे शुद्धे तु दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा <ls>Ś. 7. 32</ls>. .²3 Resemblance, likeness; क्षित्यादीनामिहार्थानां छाया न कतमापि हि <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 59</ls>. .²4 A shadowy fancy, hallucination; असता छाययोक्ताय सदाभासाय ते नमः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 3. 14</ls>. .²5 Blending of colours. .²6 Lustre, light; भ्रष्टश्च स्वरयोगो मे छाया चापगता मम <ls>Rām. 2. 69. 20</ls>. छायामण्डललक्ष्येण <ls>R. 4. 5</ls>; रत्नच्छायाव्यतिकरः <ls>Me. 15</ls>, <ls n="Me.">35</ls>. .²7 Colour; <ls>Māl. 6. 5</ls>. .²8 Colour of the face, complexion; केवलं लावण्यमयी छाया त्वां न मुञ्चति <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; मेघैरन्तरितः प्रिये तव मुखच्छायानुकारी शशी <ls>S. D.</ls>; <ls>Pt. 5. 88</ls>. .²9 Beauty क्षामच्छायं भवनम् <ls>Me. 80</ls>, <ls n="Me.">104</ls>. .²10 Protection. .²11 A row, line. .²12 Darkness; (metaphorically) Avidyā; छायातपौ यत्र न गृध्रपक्षौ <ls>Bhāg. 8. 5. 27</ls>. .²13 A bribe. .²14 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²15 The shadow of a gnomon as indicating the sunʼs position. .²16 The Sun. .²17 Nightmare. .²18 <ab>N.</ab> of a wife of the sun (she was but a shadow or likeness of संज्ञा, the wife of the sun; consequently when संज्ञा went to her fatherʼs house without the knowledge of her husband, she put छाया in her own place. छाया bore to the sun three children:-- two sons Sāvarṇi and Śani, and one daughter Tapanī). .²19 A Sanskrit version of a Prākṛt text. .²20 The Ganges; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²21 Method; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²22 A servantʼs chit; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-यः@} One who grants shade.
